description_en: Queries the number of assets that are under DDoS attacks in a specific region. The assets are assigned public IP addresses
description_zh: 查询指定地域下正在遭受DDoS攻击的公网IP资产的数量
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public describe-ddos-count --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDdosCount

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset to query. Valid values:

ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.

slb: Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances.

eip: elastic IP addresses (EIPs).

ipv6: IPv6 gateways.

swas: simple application servers.

waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF) instances of the Exclusive edition.

ga_basic: Global Accelerator (GA) instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

ecs：表示查询云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示查询负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示查询弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示查询IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示查询轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示查询Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示查询全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

DdosCount.description_en: The number of assets that are under DDoS attacks
DdosCount.description_zh: 正在遭受DDoS攻击的实例数量详情

BlackholeCount.description_en: The number of assets for which blackhole filtering is triggered
BlackholeCount.description_zh: 处于黑洞状态的实例的数量

DefenseCount.description_en: The number of assets for which traffic scrubbing is triggered
DefenseCount.description_zh: 正在进行攻击流量清洗的实例的数量
